_comment: Which merge-gate job runs which test suites, and which path-filter outputs enable it (#942).
Declared, not derived: the `dotnet test` invocations are NOT in the workflow. merge-gate.yml launches
bench/aws/run-gate.sh and its maintained parallel copy bench/aws/ci.sky.yaml, and those scripts name the
projects. Deriving 'which job runs which suite' from the workflow alone would report full coverage of
whatever those scripts do not run, which is the false green check-gate-filters.py exists to remove.
The checker asserts every job named here is defined in the workflow, and that every project exists, so the
table cannot silently claim coverage that does not exist. `filters` is an OR: the job runs when any is true.
